intent: six static UI concept storyboards, not implementation

prompts.title: 01 ミニバン・スライド
prompts.detail: The lower control is a wide low-profile rounded pale-gray horizontal track, not a giant button. A tiny side-view 3D white kei van is the draggable thumb, pointed to the RIGHT. The user moves it horizontally toward a modest yellow QR framing icon at the far right. At rest van is far left; mid-state van is 60% right with 2 restrained motion marks and a short soft amber trail; final state van settles flush at the destination, with one small suspension settle and the right end expanding into QR camera framing. The main hero van above remains stationary. Only this little track can have 2-3 abstract dash markers, not a rendered road environment. In-phone label "スライドで撮影へ". Board title exactly "01 ミニバン・スライド". This should be the most intuitively useful, warm and playful candidate.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution landscape product design concept board for the Japanese delivery-driver iPhone app ハコ虎, approximately 1536x1024. Realistic, highly polished app UI and delightful but restrained microinteraction design. This is a static storyboard, not a claim of working animation.
Composition: off-white presentation board with ample margins. Upper left a crisp Japanese concept number and title. LEFT 38%: a front-on iPhone screen mockup WITHOUT hardware frame, showing existing app layout: small "9月23日（水）", heading "今日の稼働", subheading "中央エリア", a miniature 3D white Suzuki Every-style Japanese kei cargo van with opaque blue-gray windows isolated on plain pale-gray background and soft contact shadow, label "エブリイ 12-34", a compact white parking card "中央車庫 3番区画". At bottom the UNIQUE interaction control described below, and a compact native translucent 5-icon tab bar. No streets, trees, clouds, scenery or roadway behind the main van. No yellow developer banners or gear overlay.
RIGHT 57%: three generously sized sequential close-up crops of this exact unique interaction, stacked vertically, each clearly showing a different state with short Japanese annotation on the surrounding board: "触れる前", "操作中", "撮影へ". This area is the main focus; show the actual design difference and how it moves rather than three duplicate buttons. A faint trajectory/arrow may appear on the board outside app UI. The final closeup hints at a camera framing view with a NONSCANNABLE decorative QR target; do NOT imply completed work or actual vehicle unlocking/ignition. The application is a workflow launcher, not a remote vehicle controller.
Visual system: Apple-quality spatial depth and restrained Liquid Glass, very subtle shadows, neutral pale-gray #F6F8FB, white, dark navy #192333, warm workwear yellow #FFC52C as main accent, no purple/neon. Legible clean Japanese sans serif, subtle low-poly van character without faces/mascots. Font Awesome-style monochrome icons, never emoji. Keep screen UI text sparse and static, no "そのまま", no "長押し" subtitle changing, no tutorial paragraphs, no massive ring gauge, no confetti, no stars, no race-game scores, no hands obscuring the controls. It must feel useful for adult delivery drivers, playfulness through tactility. Main action text may say "車両を確認" or "撮影へ". Keep ordinary parking/vehicle info consistent across all concept panels. Distinctive interaction should be readable at small size.

prompts.title: 02 ガラスのリボン
prompts.detail: The lower control is a wide premium frosted-glass capsule with a rounded yellow thumb bearing a simple RIGHT CHEVRON. As it is dragged right, a soft translucent amber ribbon stretches elastically BEHIND it, with a rounded narrow waist attaching to the origin. A delicate refraction edge, no slime/cartoon goo. At rest, small yellow glass bead at left; mid-state amber ribbon stretches to 65% with the thumb under direct control; at the right edge it cleanly resolves into a compact QR camera window. Three stages must clearly illustrate elastic length and graceful release. Do not add a miniature vehicle inside the control. In-phone label "スライドで撮影へ". Board title exactly "02 ガラスのリボン". Sophisticated contemporary tactile glass, not glossy skeuomorphic chrome.

prompts.title: 03 出発チケット
prompts.detail: The lower interaction is a compact white dispatch ticket with softly clipped corners, dark navy printed "エブリイ 12-34", a fine perforated divider and a yellow pull tab on the RIGHT with a chevron. It belongs to this vehicle, not payments or rewards. User pulls the yellow tab horizontally RIGHT, and the ticket peels/slides open to uncover a clean camera framing symbol and "撮影へ". At rest the ticket is tidy and partly nested; mid-state the yellow tab extends right and ticket reveals a warm yellow inner layer; complete the unfolded ticket becomes the QR camera frame. Paper is premium matte with subtle folded edge, not aged parchment. Elegant tactile microinteraction, no torn litter or confetti. The ticket must be wide enough to grip within a normal phone. Board title exactly "03 出発チケット". This is visibly a slide-to-open ticket, NOT a generic slider capsule.

prompts.title: 04 シャッター
prompts.detail: The lower control is a compact 110px-tall rounded rectangular vehicle-confirmation panel, resembling a minimal garage shutter only through three soft horizontal slats. A yellow horizontal handle near the bottom has a simple UP chevron. User drags this handle UP a SHORT distance. At rest panel closed, label "車両を確認"; mid-state lower edge lifted to halfway, revealing a navy QR CAMERA view behind; complete panel rolls out of view and a camera framing screen appears. Draw no actual garage or architectural background, no remote garage control, just a subtle shutter metaphor inside the app's action panel. Do not use a horizontal swipe. Three closeups show closed, half-raised, fully-open. Board title exactly "04 シャッター". Refined tactile object, restrained depth, purposeful workflow transition.

prompts.title: 05 ヘッドライト
prompts.detail: This is a PRESS-AND-HOLD concept with NO ring gauge. A calm wide yellow pill action says "車両を確認", same text throughout. The assigned 3D kei van above is the main feedback: two headlights gradually warm from dark to softly lit as holding continues. A thin understated horizontal luminous strip at the bottom edge of the button quietly fills from left to right to show remaining duration. At rest headlights off; mid-state very soft warm light cones reveal a little surface beneath the vehicle, not a road; full state headlights glow gently once and the surface transitions to the QR camera. Do not create intense glare, laser beams, rays across text or a real engine ignition control. Board closeups must include both vehicle front and button so the connection is visible. Board title exactly "05 ヘッドライト". Satisfying gentle light, minimal playful detail.

prompts.title: 06 サスペンション
prompts.detail: This is a PRESS-AND-HOLD concept with no circles or ring gauge. The lower action is a wide soft yellow rectangular key with a shallow beveled edge, label "車両を確認". Pressing makes this key sink just 2px; simultaneously the hero miniature van's body gently compresses down onto its springs while ALL wheels remain in contact with the plain ground and the soft shadow widens slightly. A thin linear underline fills calmly to indicate duration. At completion the miniature body returns with ONE tiny elastic settle, while the key opens into QR camera framing. No airborne jump, no shaking, no smoke. Three stages show rest, compressed (use subtle overlay ghost contour or small outside arrows to clarify the tiny movement), and soft rebound/camera. The board should clearly communicate tactile cushioning, not vehicle damage or a literal suspension control. Board title exactly "06 サスペンション". A collectible miniature model responding to touch, understated adult playful feel.
